faces.transcription:
This is a pursuit objective.

To set it up, place a Pursuit token in Los Angeles.

Then, place this card onto the board in the Operations area and flip it over.

JULY OBJECTIVE 1

STOP DEFECTOR FROM DELIVERING SECRETS

Remove the last Pursuit token from the board

STARTING CITY: LOS ANGELES
DESTINATION: ANY SOVIET CITY

Completed: Read Debrief 141
Failed (First half of month): Read Debrief 112
Failed (Second half of month): Read Debrief 232
